changes.en: Close to 100 % fat against about 80 % in butter. Lard is a semi-solid fat with a higher smoke point than butter.
changes.de: Fast 100 % Fett gegenüber etwa 80 % in Butter. Schmalz ist ein halbfestes Fett mit höherem Rauchpunkt als Butter.

sources.title: Understanding Ingredients for the Canadian Baker (BC Cook Articulation Committee, BCcampus)
sources.place: chapter 3.3 Major Fats and Oils Used in Bakeries, section Shortening
sources.sentence: Lard and shortening have a higher fat content (close to 100%) compared to about 80% for butter and margarine.

sources.title: Understanding Ingredients for the Canadian Baker (BC Cook Articulation Committee, BCcampus)
sources.place: chapter 3.3 Major Fats and Oils Used in Bakeries, section Shortening
sources.sentence: Vegetable shortening shares many properties with lard: both are semi-solid fats with a higher smoke point than butter and margarine.
